# EXL3 vLLM adapter provenance

`exl3.py` is Apache-2.0 Python source from
[`local-inference-lab/vllm`](https://github.com/local-inference-lab/vllm/blob/30038602b71395f481ef4a6edfe4fcf8551d9c15/vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/exl3.py)
at commit `30038602b71395f481ef4a6edfe4fcf8551d9c15`.
The imported file's SHA-256 is
`6181cecd32792f2f747052496ee0f8b33cbbccff8ae9092f78d0e8acbb33491a`.
The Dots3 integration is kept in `serving/dots3_exl3_fp8.py` and
`serving/port_vllm.py` until the B12x path is validated.
